title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Members: Paid-Delivery Uplift on Marlowe Rewards Goodwill
content:
A Marlowe Rewards service goodwill grant carries a paid-delivery uplift when the member holds a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan in force. The uplift is larger when the affected order was shipped by one of the faster delivery services of Online Orders.

## The uplift

| Member's Unlimited plan | Delivery service of the affected order | Paid-delivery uplift |
|---|---|---|
| In status active or cancellation pending | Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day or Same-Day Courier | 40 percent |
| In status active or cancellation pending | Any other delivery service: Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery or Standard Ground | 20 percent |
| No plan, or a plan in trial, past due or expired | any | none |

The affected order is the order the approved delivery claim was opened on.

## How the uplift acts

The uplift is a percentage of the grant's starting figure. It is added to the grant before the grant is rounded and limited.

## Illustration (hypothetical starting figure of 150 points)

| Position | Uplift added |
|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Annual, active; order shipped Next Business Day | 60 points |
| Unlimited Express Monthly, cancellation pending; order shipped Standard Ground | 30 points |
| Unlimited plan expired; order shipped Same-Day Courier | none |
